## About
Rockwall Auto Repair is a family-owned and operated, full-service auto repair shop on Davy Crockett St in Rockwall. Our team has hands-on experience with all kinds of vehicles, from classic cars to new ones.
Our ASE certified technicians handle brakes, heating and air conditioning, suspension, tune-ups and general maintenance and repairs. We keep a clean shop and use up-to-date equipment and techniques to get your car running right.
One reviewer wrote that Lance does what he says he's going to do.

## Services
- Brake service: Brake inspections, rotor and pad replacement, front and rear disc brake repair, rear drum brake repair and parking brake adjustment.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heating and air conditioning service for your vehicle.
- Full-service auto repair: General repair work for foreign, domestic and European vehicles, from classic cars to new ones.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We service all foreign, domestic and European vehicles, from classic cars to new ones.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Free estimates are part of how we work. Give us a call to set up an appointment.

Q: How do I know if my brakes need to be checked?
A: Watch for squealing or grinding noises, the car pulling to one side when braking, a low or hard pedal, pedal vibration or the brake light coming on. If you notice any of these, call us or bring your vehicle in.
